channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Doshisha chairman apologizes over fatal boat accident in Okinawa
item.description: Eiji Hatta, chairman of Doshisha's board of trustees, offered his "deepest condolences" at a news conference in Kyoto on Friday.

item.title: Japan considers paying low-income workers ¥5,000 through benefit program
item.description: Under the program, a fixed amount is expected to be given to people in work who earn ¥1.19 million or less annually.

item.title: Seven years after fire, Okinawa’s Shuri Castle inches away from reopening
item.description: Final preparations are underway to reopen the main hall of the castle next month.

item.title: Japan demands release of national in meeting with Russia’s Lavrov
item.description: The rare high-level meeting between the two countries came amid strained ties over Ukraine and a long-running territorial dispute.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
